ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's payment obligations are not damages and are not limited by this Section.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Because "Fees" is defined as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, we re-based the mutual cap on the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and broadened the carve-back so Customer's payment obligations generally (not just undisputed Fees for conforming Services) are not damages. Mutuality, the damages exclusions in 21.2 and the Excluded Claims in 21.3 are untouched.
proposal.summary: Re-base the mutual cap on fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim with a USD 1,000,000 floor, and confirm Customer's payment obligations are not damages.

mappings.quote: The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.

mappings.element: Cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

mappings.quote: neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages
Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages
“Excluded Claims” means a Party's breach of confidentiality
